sloka: सा तम् संप्रेक्ष्य सुश्रोणी कुसुमानि विचिन्वती ।हेम राजत वर्णाभ्याम् पार्श्वाभ्याम् उपशोभितम् ॥३-४३-१॥
transliteration: sā tam saṁprekṣya suśroṇī kusumāni vicinvatī ।hema rājata varṇābhyām pārśvābhyām upaśobhitam ॥3-43-1॥

translations.english: Sita while plucking flowers Sita who had fine hips, flawless beautiful limbs and pure golden complexion felt delighted to see the deer with gold and silver colours on both sides of his body. She called out to Rama and Lakshmana who were equipped with arms.
translations.hindi: फूलों को चुनती हुई सीता जी ने उस मग को देखा, जो सोने और रूपे के रंग वाली कोखों से सुभोभित था
